title: SPTS-JM: sampled-pivot search with exact one-third joint-marginal tolerance

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE SPTS-JM physical program selected by proof.md executes the exact included SPTS1/RQ-SPLIT gates, integer parameters and hard caps under the FIXED original joint-state good-marginal model of proof.md Section1. All Q=3*2^40(n+32) sources are acquired sequentially and compressed, then the private late split, sampled-pivot selector (bounded RQ finite fallback at n<64), final full-record champion and untouched even-N endpoint are executed. At most floor(Q/3) positions are bad; their arbitrary joint extension may entangle with good systems, whose original reduced state is exactly the ideal product. Unconditional entire-secret success is STRICTLY greater than11/16. Full-reference extraction coupling, hypergeometric counts, good-first score proof and unconditional endpoint binomial law are supplied here, without assuming conditionally fresh good states or conditioning on all labels/coarse success. All resources hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch, including discarded work, errors, aborts, all allocated padding, full addresses, generator bit work, source fees, initialization and complete cleanup. No QRAM, source inverse/control, supplied purification or arbitrary rotation primitive is used. Charged sequential time is O(2^((1/2)n)n(log2n)^3) for n>=2, with n=1 explicitly finite. Exact time growth index1; the coefficient1/2 multiplies n, not sqrt(n). Hard token debits, not expected work, bound every coarse branch.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
